settings.biological_type_residuals: none, same A usage within a subject when a-effect=0
settings.baseline: label-blind mean of generating transcript weights, diagnostic oracle
settings.test_model: same random-subject Beta EC LRT for all three read selections
settings.latent_model: independent A/B path composition, four Cartesian-product transcripts

scope: Controlled independent-block misspecification challenge, not real-data split/LR performance
failure_policy: all requested trials retained, failed p=1 and effects unavailable
